title: MSFS 2024 keeps crashing? Find the EXACT add-On with AI
description:
Are random crashes to desktop (CTD) ruining your flights in Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024? Instead of waiting days for support tickets or guessing which Community mod is broken, you can analyze your simulator's raw crash dump files yourself using AI!

In this step-by-step tutorial, learn how to locate hidden .dmp files in your Windows AppData directory and use Claude AI to translate complex memory errors, GPU overloads, and broken WASM community mods into plain English.

🛠️ What you’ll learn:

📂 Locate Raw Dump Files: Find hidden .dmp files in %localappdata%\CrashDumps  
📜 Read ASO Logs: Access plain-text crash logs in Packages\Microsoft.Limitless...\LocalState\  
🤖 AI Prompting: The exact method to analyze raw dumps using Claude's free tier  
🧩 Identify Broken Mods: Instantly spot culprit WASM modules and background hooks (RivaTuner, Tobii, OBS)  
🥽 VR & Hardware Fixes: Diagnose GPU-removed errors and heavy memory overloads during VR flights  

📁 Crash Paths Referenced:
- Windows Mini-Dumps: %localappdata%\CrashDumps  
- Flight Simulator State Logs: %localappdata%\Packages\Microsoft.Limitless...\LocalState\
